run_script.text:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Issue 4 (arXiv): FLOURINE rebuilt in its own check profile (--profile fuzz). Mirrors
# harness/oracle_ub_run.sh flourine_current (rust phase in crust-syzygy, C phase in crust-heldout),
# with python3 -I, --cpus 4, and every write under ~/work/arxiv-flprofile.
set -euo pipefail
W="$HOME/work/arxiv-flprofile"
REPO="$W/repo"; ART="$W/artifacts"; SHARED="$W/build"
export OUB_GIT_REV="40bc85c (arxiv branch) + uncommitted --profile flags in systems/flourine/run.py, run_struct.py, harness/oracle_ub_flourine_current.py"
export OUB_HOST="$(hostname) ($(uname -m), $(nproc) cores)"
export OUB_WORKTREE_NOTE="Mac study repo working tree rsynced (out/, artifacts/, .git excluded) to $W/repo; artifacts rsynced to $W/artifacts (source digests equal the shipped run)"
export OUB_RUST_IMAGE=crust-syzygy
OUB_RUST_IMAGE_ID=$(docker image inspect crust-syzygy --format "{{.Id}}"); export OUB_RUST_IMAGE_ID
run_in() {
  local img="$1"; shift
  local iid; iid=$(docker image inspect "$img" --format "{{.Id}}")
  docker run --rm --ulimit core=0 --cpus 4 \
    -e OUB_GIT_REV -e OUB_HOST -e OUB_WORKTREE_NOTE -e OUB_IMAGE="$img" -e OUB_IMAGE_ID="$iid" \
    -e OUB_COMMAND="bash run_flourine_fuzz.sh: $* (docker image $img $iid, --cpus 4)" \
    -e OUB_RUST_IMAGE -e OUB_RUST_IMAGE_ID \
    -v "$REPO:/work" -v "$ART:$ART:ro" -v "$SHARED:/oub" -w /work "$img" "$@"
}
B=/oub/flourine_current_fuzz
mkdir -p "$SHARED/out"
if [ "${SKIP_RUST:-0}" != 1 ]; then
  run_in crust-syzygy python3 -I harness/oracle_ub_flourine_current.py --phase rust --jobs 6 --build $B --profile fuzz
fi
run_in crust-heldout python3 -I harness/oracle_ub_flourine_current.py --phase c --jobs 4 --build $B \
  --out-scalar /oub/out/flourine_diff_current_fuzz.json --out-struct /oub/out/flourine_struct_current_fuzz.json
echo DONE
